author: Gergely Harcos
title: Weil’s bound for Kloosterman sums
locator: Theorem 1, page 1; PDF parsed lines 5–21 from actual connected web open
claim: For an odd prime p and two parameters not divisible by p, the ordinary Kloosterman sum over F_p units has magnitude at most 2 sqrt(p).
original_classical_publication_metadata: André Weil, On Some Exponential Sums, PNAS 34(5), 1948, 204–207, DOI 10.1073/pnas.34.5.204; metadata verified via PMC search, original full paper not read
parameter_statement_exact_checked: Theorem 1 (Weil). Let p > 2 be a prime number. Let a and b be integers coprime to p.
